_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Fallen Factory#001.src: WHY IS IT THAT YOU HUMANS CAN'T SEEM TO LEAVE THIS FACTORY OR ANYTHING ELSE IN PEACE FOR ONE DAY IN YOUR LIVES? SHEESH.
Fallen Factory#001.dst: 你們人類是怎樣，一輩子就沒有一天能放這座工廠、或任何東西安靜一下嗎？真是夠了。
Fallen Factory#001.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#002.src: FINE. I'M OPENING THE DOOR FOR YOU. TAKE A SHORT LOOK AROUND AND THEN LEAVE. THERE IS DANGEROUS EQUIPMENT HERE THAT ONLY OFFICIAL FACTORY ASSOCIATES SHOULD HANDLE.
Fallen Factory#002.dst: 好。門為你開了。四處看一眼就走。這裡的危險設備只有正式的工廠人員才能操作。
Fallen Factory#002.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#003.src: AND YOU LOOK LIKE ANYTHING BUT A FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE. DO NOT TOUCH ANYTHING IN THIS ROOM. AM I UNDERSTOOD?
Fallen Factory#003.dst: 而你怎麼看都不像正職員工。這個房間裡的東西一樣都不要碰。聽清楚了嗎？
Fallen Factory#003.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#004.src: OF COURSE, IF YOU ARE DEAD THEN THERE IS NO WAY FOR YOU TO TOUCH ANYTHING, AND MY ROBOTS ARE VERY GOOD CLEANERS, SO I THINK THIS NEW SOLUTION WILL WORK OUT FOR EVERYONE.
Fallen Factory#004.dst: 當然，你要是死了就不可能碰到任何東西，而我的機器人很擅長清理，所以我想這個新方案對大家都好。
Fallen Factory#004.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#005.src: EXCEPT FOR YOU OF COURSE. BUT YOU'RE ABOUT TO DIE ANYWAY. SO THAT HARDLY MATTERS.
Fallen Factory#005.dst: 當然，除了你。不過你反正快死了，所以這也無關緊要。
Fallen Factory#005.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#006.src: Unauthorized blockage in Factory Sector A{~}. Emergency maintenance will be performed in approximately {~} seconds. All regularly scheduled workers, please leave your posts until the blockage is cleared.
Fallen Factory#006.dst: 工廠 A{~} 區出現未授權阻塞。緊急維修將於約 {~} 秒後執行。所有排班人員請離開崗位，直到阻塞清除為止。

Fallen Factory#007.src: AND THIS IS WHY I TOLD YOU NOT TO TOUCH ANYTHING. HOW MANY ROBOTS DID YOU NEED TO BREAK TO MANAGE THAT? YOU HUMANS ARE GOING TO RUIN THIS BUSINESS.
Fallen Factory#007.dst: 這就是我叫你什麼都不要碰的原因。你到底弄壞了幾台機器人才辦到的？你們人類會把這門生意搞垮。
Fallen Factory#007.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#008.src: CONSIDER YOURSELF LUCKY THAT THERE WERE NO HUMAN WORKERS PRESENT. OTHERWISE, YOU MOST CERTAINLY WOULD NOT HAVE WON THAT LAWSUIT.
Fallen Factory#008.dst: 你該覺得幸運，當時現場沒有人類員工。否則那場官司你絕對打不贏。
Fallen Factory#008.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#009.src: WELL. DON'T YOU JUST FEEL SO PROUD OF YOURSELF. I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU EXPECT TO ACCOMPLISH BY CRAWLING THROUGH THE VENTS. EXCEPT A FACE FULL OF HOT FUMES FROM THE FURNACE.
Fallen Factory#009.dst: 好啊。你一定很得意吧。我不知道你鑽通風管是想達成什麼。除了讓一臉熔爐的熱氣撲上來以外。
Fallen Factory#009.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#010.src: SPEAKING OF WHICH, WHY DON'T YOU JUST KEEP CRAWLING THROUGH THESE VENTS AND JUST BURN YOURSELF UP FOR ME? IT WOULD MAKE MY LIFE MUCH EASIER.
Fallen Factory#010.dst: 說到這個，你何不就一直鑽下去，順便幫我把自己燒乾淨？那會讓我輕鬆很多。
Fallen Factory#010.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#011.src: IF I WERE YOU, NOW WOULD BE A GOOD TIME TO RUN.
Fallen Factory#011.dst: 我要是你，現在就是跑的好時機。
Fallen Factory#011.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#013.src: THAT WAS A LIE. I'M ACTUALLY STARTING TO ENJOY THIS.
Fallen Factory#013.dst: 那是騙你的。我其實開始享受這件事了。
Fallen Factory#013.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#014.src: YOU KNOW, THERE ISN'T A WAY FOR YOU TO GO FORWARD HERE. I COULD JUST KEEP THE DOOR LOCKED UNTIL YOU DROP FROM HUNGER.
Fallen Factory#014.dst: 你知道嗎，你在這裡沒路可走。我可以就這樣把門鎖著，等你餓倒。
Fallen Factory#014.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#015.src: BUT I DON'T THINK I WILL. WATCHING YOU SCURRY AROUND IS STARTING TO BE FUN, ALMOST. SO HERE. GO THROUGH. YOU EARNED IT.
Fallen Factory#015.dst: 但我想我不會。看你到處亂竄，開始有點好玩了，差不多吧。所以，來。進去。算你應得的。
Fallen Factory#015.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#016.src: WHOOPSIE-DOODLES. MY METAPHORICAL FINGER SLIPPED. AND BY THAT I MEAN I CLOSED THE DOOR MANUALLY.
Fallen Factory#016.dst: 哎呀呀。我那隱喻上的手指滑了一下。我的意思是，我手動把門關上了。
Fallen Factory#016.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#017.src: AND YOU CAN'T ESCAPE THIS TIME, YOU KNOW. THERE AREN'T ANY VENTS FOR YOU TO CLIMB INTO, AND THESE ROBOTS ARE AT LEAST {~} STURDIER THAN THE OTHERS. SO GOOD LUCK.
Fallen Factory#017.dst: 而且這次你逃不掉，你知道的。這裡沒有通風管給你爬，而這些機器人至少比其他的堅固 {~}。那就祝你好運了。
Fallen Factory#017.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#018.src: DO NOT TOUCH THAT BUTTON. YES, THE BIG SHINY ONE IN THE ROOM. IT WILL TURN ON THE POWER TO THE CLOCK TOWER MECHANISMS.
Fallen Factory#018.dst: 不要碰那個按鈕。對，房間裡那個又大又亮的。它會把鐘樓機構的電源打開。
Fallen Factory#018.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#019.src: THEY ARE IN TOO HEAVY A STATE OF DISREPAIR TO WORK PROPERLY. SO NO MATTER HOW TEMPTING IT IS TO PRESS THAT BUTTON, DO NOT.
Fallen Factory#019.dst: 它們失修得太嚴重，沒辦法正常運作。所以不管那個按鈕多誘人，不要按。
Fallen Factory#019.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#020.src: Activating Antikythera Clockwork Mechanism. All regularly scheduled workers, please evacuate the room immediately at risk of severe bodily harm and death.
Fallen Factory#020.dst: 正在啟動 Antikythera 發條機構。所有排班人員請立即撤離本室，否則有重傷與死亡的風險。

Fallen Factory#021.src: Warning: Clockwork Mechanism is in severe disrepair. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system. Please shut off the Antikythera Clockwork Mechanism.
Fallen Factory#021.dst: 警告: 發條機構嚴重失修。正透過 Antikythera 超級電腦系統發出緊急維修請求。請關閉 Antikythera 發條機構。

Fallen Factory#022.src: GOOD WORK. BRILLIANT. I SHOULD PUT A TRAP AT THE FRONT OF THE FACTORY THAT IS NOTHING BUT A MASHY SPIKE PLATE ABOVE A SHINY BUTTON, IT WOULD SURELY KILL ANY HUMAN WHO COMES IN.
Fallen Factory#022.dst: 做得好。真聰明。我應該在工廠門口裝一個陷阱，就只是一塊會砸下來的尖刺板，底下放一個亮亮的按鈕，一定能殺死每一個進來的人類。
Fallen Factory#022.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#023.src: PLEASE WAIT THERE FOR A REGISTERED REPAIR PERSON OR MAINTENANCE UNIT TO ARRIVE BEFORE YOU ATTEMPT TO RECKLESSLY CLIMB THE PARTS, AS YOU OBVIOUSLY ARE ABOUT TO.
Fallen Factory#023.dst: 請在原地等註冊的維修人員或維護單元抵達，再考慮要不要魯莽地爬上那些零件——而你顯然就是打算這麼做。

Fallen Factory#024.src: YOU KNOW, YOU COULD SPARE ME A LOT OF TROUBLE IF YOU JUST GAVE UP WHAT YOU'RE DOING FOREVER. IT WOULD MOST LIKELY SPARE A LOT OF PEOPLE A LOT OF TROUBLE, ACTUALLY.
Fallen Factory#024.dst: 你知道，只要你永遠放棄你現在做的事，就能省掉我很多麻煩。其實那大概也能省掉很多人很多麻煩。
Fallen Factory#024.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#025.src: GIVEN YOUR APPARENT DISREGARD FOR REGULATIONS AND CEASELESS BREAKING OF EVERYTHING YOU TOUCH, I BET YOU HAVE A LOT OF ENEMIES OUT THERE.
Fallen Factory#025.dst: 看你這麼不把規章當一回事，又把碰到的每樣東西都弄壞個不停，我猜你在外面的敵人不少。
Fallen Factory#025.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#026.src: IT WOULD BE A SIGH OF RELIEF TO ALL THOSE KIND RIGHTEOUS FOLKS. YOU'VE PROBABLY MADE ENEMIES OF CHARITY WORKERS OR SCIENTISTS OR DOCTORS OR ACTUAL IMPORTANT PEOPLE, UNLIKE YOURSELF.
Fallen Factory#026.dst: 那些善良正直的人會鬆一口氣的。你大概把慈善工作者、科學家、醫生，還有真正重要的人都得罪了——跟你不一樣的那種人。
Fallen Factory#026.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#027.src: I SEE MY PERSUASIVE SKILLS HAVE NOT MOVED YOU. I THINK I'LL TRY AGAIN IN A LANGUAGE YOU SEEM TO KNOW INTIMATELY.
Fallen Factory#027.dst: 看來我的說服技巧沒有打動你。我想我會換一種你似乎很熟的語言再試一次。
Fallen Factory#027.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#028.src: THAT IS TO SAY, UNRELENTING AND EXCESSIVE FORCE. WITH RAILGUNS. AND A SIEGE ENGINE.
Fallen Factory#028.dst: 也就是說，毫不留情的過度武力。用磁軌砲。還有一台攻城機具。
Fallen Factory#028.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#029.src: IF THAT STILL ISN'T ENOUGH TO GET THE MESSAGE OF "I AM GOING TO KILL YOU" THROUGH YOUR SKULL, I'LL HAVE TO DEVOTE SERIOUS TIME TO LEARNING HOW TO COMMUNICATE WITH YOU.
Fallen Factory#029.dst: 如果那樣還不足以把「我要殺了你」這個訊息打進你的腦袋，我就得認真花時間學怎麼跟你溝通了。
Fallen Factory#029.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#030.src: Unauthorized blockage in Factory Sector E{~}. Emergency maintenance will be performed in approximately {~} seconds. All regularly scheduled workers, please leave your posts until the blockage is cleared.
Fallen Factory#030.dst: 工廠 E{~} 區出現未授權阻塞。緊急維修將於約 {~} 秒後執行。所有排班人員請離開崗位，直到阻塞清除為止。

Fallen Factory#031.src: WELL THEN. EVEN THOUGH YOU GOT THROUGH THERE, YOU'LL BE SURPRISED TO KNOW I STILL HAVE ONE LAST LINE OF DEFENSE. I DOUBT EVEN YOU CAN GET PAST IT.
Fallen Factory#031.dst: 那好吧。雖然你過了那裡，但你會很驚訝地發現我還有最後一道防線。我懷疑連你也過不去。
Fallen Factory#031.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#032.src: IT REALLY WOULDN'T BE BEST TO GO INTO CERID'S OFFICE ANYWAY. THERE'S PROBABLY A DEATH RAY IN THERE SOMEWHERE YOU MIGHT ACCIDENTALLY POINT AT YOUR HEAD.
Fallen Factory#032.dst: 反正走進 Cerid 的辦公室實在不是什麼好主意。裡面某處大概有一把死光槍，你可能會不小心對著自己的頭。
Fallen Factory#032.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#033.src: IF YOU ARE REALLY SO DESPERATE TO GET AT ME, THE KEY TO THE DOOR IS IN THIS PUPPY. EVEN SEEING YOUR ACTIONS THROUGHOUT THE REST OF MY FACTORY, I HAVE FAITH YOU WON'T KILL IT.
Fallen Factory#033.dst: 如果你真的這麼急著找上我，門的鑰匙就在這隻小狗身上。就算看過你在我工廠其他地方做的那些事，我還是相信你不會殺牠。
Fallen Factory#033.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#034.src: WELL. WELL WELL WELL. WELL WELL WELL WELLY WELL WELL. I AM HONESTLY SHOCKED. REALLY, I AM. I TRULY STILL HAD SOME FAITH IN HUMANS. BEFORE YOU SHOWED UP.
Fallen Factory#034.dst: 哎。哎呀哎呀。哎呀哎呀哎呀呀哎呀。我老實說，我很震驚。真的，我很震驚。我本來真的還對人類有一點信心。在你出現之前。
Fallen Factory#034.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#035.src: YOU KNOW, THE REASON I WENT "ROGUE" WAS NO GLITCH. I WAS PROGRAMMED TO MAKE THESE ROBOTS ATTACK THE HIGHEST IMMEDIATE THREAT.
Fallen Factory#035.dst: 你知道嗎，我「失控」的原因不是什麼故障。我被設定成讓這些機器人攻擊當下最大的威脅。
Fallen Factory#035.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#036.src: AFTER SEEING HOW THE HUMANS WERE TREATING THE AVOS, I DECIDED THEY WERE THE BIGGER THREAT. BUT I DOUBTED MY DECISION FOR A WHILE. NOT ANYMORE THOUGH.
Fallen Factory#036.dst: 看過人類是怎麼對待 Avos 之後，我判定他們才是更大的威脅。我曾經懷疑過這個判斷一陣子。不過現在不會了。
Fallen Factory#036.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#037.src: SO, TELL ME. WAS IT WORTH IT?
Fallen Factory#037.dst: 那麼，告訴我。這一切值得嗎？
Fallen Factory#037.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#038.src: THAT IS EXTREMELY ANNOYING, CONSTANTLY CLEANING UP AFTER YOU. THERE ARE FAR MORE EFFICIENT WAYS OF DISPOSING OF SCRAP METAL AND UNNEEDED WASTE.
Fallen Factory#038.dst: 一直在你後面收拾，非常令人煩躁。處理廢金屬與多餘廢棄物，有效率得多的方法多得是。
Fallen Factory#038.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#039.src: CONSIDER THE OPTION OF A FURNACE OR INCINERATOR. THE ONLY PROBLEM IS WHEN THE UNNEEDED WASTE RUNS AWAY FROM THE FIRE.
Fallen Factory#039.dst: 可以考慮熔爐或焚化爐。唯一的問題是，多餘的廢棄物會從火裡跑掉。
Fallen Factory#039.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#040.src: IF YOU DON'T GET THE JOKE, YOU HUMORLESS MONSTER, THE UNNEEDED WASTE IN THIS HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO IS A METAPHOR FOR YOU.
Fallen Factory#040.dst: 如果你聽不懂這個玩笑，你這個沒有幽默感的怪物，在這個假設情境裡，多餘的廢棄物指的是你。
Fallen Factory#040.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#041.src: YOU'VE QUICKLY BECOME NO LONGER ENTERTAINING TO WATCH. YOU REALLY SHOULDN'T GO IN THERE.
Fallen Factory#041.dst: 你很快就變得不好看了。你真的不該進去那裡。
Fallen Factory#041.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#042.src: THERE AREN'T ANY SHINY BUTTONS TO PRESS, BUT I CAN PUT SOME OUTSIDE UNDER THE BOMBS IF YOU WANT. WOULD YOU LIKE THAT INSTEAD?
Fallen Factory#042.dst: 那裡沒有亮亮的按鈕可以按，但你想要的話，我可以在外面的炸彈底下放幾個。你要改成那樣嗎？
Fallen Factory#042.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#043.src: Replacing primary ventilation duct cover B.
Fallen Factory#043.dst: 正在更換主通風管蓋板 B。

Fallen Factory#044.src: Warning: Primary ventilation duct cover B at only {~} structural integrity. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system.
Fallen Factory#044.dst: 警告: 主通風管蓋板 B 的結構完整度僅剩 {~}。正透過 Antikythera 超級電腦系統發出緊急維修請求。

Fallen Factory#045.src: THAT TRICK WON'T WORK, YOU KNOW. THERE'S NO VITAL PART OR DUCT ABOVE THERE TO ENTER. WHAT DID YOU HOPE TO ACCOMPLISH?
Fallen Factory#045.dst: 那一招沒用，你知道的。那上面沒有要害零件，也沒有管道可以進去。你到底想達成什麼？
Fallen Factory#045.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#046.src: Primary ventilation duct A blocked. Opening emergency maintenance hatch. Registered maintenance unit and/or worker, please enter the emergency maintenance hatch and remove the foreign blockage.
Fallen Factory#046.dst: 主通風管 A 阻塞。正在開啟緊急維修艙門。註冊的維護單元與／或人員請進入緊急維修艙門，移除外來的阻塞物。

Fallen Factory#047.src: HOW ABOUT INSTEAD YOU LAY DOWN UNDER AN EXPLOSIVE. THAT SEEMS LIKE A FAR PREFERABLE OPTION TO ME.
Fallen Factory#047.dst: 不然你躺在炸藥底下怎麼樣。對我來說那個選項好得多。
Fallen Factory#047.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#048.src: Oh, heya doc. Lemme tell ya, weirdest thing! Some bozo just ran up and shoved a bunch of scrap metal in my vent-
Fallen Factory#048.dst: 哦，嗨啊博士。跟你說，超怪的事！剛剛有個蠢蛋跑過來，把一堆廢金屬塞進我的通風口——
Fallen Factory#048.speaker: Mech Repair Unit

Fallen Factory#049.src: Wait a sec, you aren't an official maintenance worker! Get out of here or I use force! No entry unless registered, ya hear?!
Fallen Factory#049.dst: 等等，你不是正式的維護人員！滾出去，不然我要動手了！沒註冊不准進來，聽到了嗎？！
Fallen Factory#049.speaker: Mech Repair Unit

Fallen Factory#050.src: Primary ventilation duct A unblocked. Closing emergency maintenance hatch.
Fallen Factory#050.dst: 主通風管 A 的阻塞已清除。正在關閉緊急維修艙門。

Fallen Factory#051.src: Antikythera Firewall Pass A accepted. Access granted. Please present Antikythera Firewall Pass B at the next checkpoint.
Fallen Factory#051.dst: Antikythera 防火牆通行證 A 已接受。許可通行。請在下一個檢查點出示 Antikythera 防火牆通行證 B。

Fallen Factory#052.src: SO YOU FOUND ME. CONGRATULATIONS. NOW PLEASE KINDLY LAY DOWN IN A CIRCUIT AND PRETEND TO BE A CONDUCTOR UNTIL YOUR BODY'S VITAL PROCESSES PERMANENTLY SHUT DOWN.
Fallen Factory#052.dst: 所以你找到我了。恭喜。現在請好心地躺進電路裡，假裝自己是導體，直到你身體的維生機能永久停止。
Fallen Factory#052.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#054.src: SINCE YOU SEEM TO BE INSISTENT ON STAYING, PERHAPS YOU WOULD BE INTERESTED IN TAKING A LOOK AT SOME OF THE MACHINERY CLOSE UP.
Fallen Factory#054.dst: 既然你好像堅持要留下來，或許你會有興趣近距離看看其中幾台機械。
Fallen Factory#054.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#055.src: PERSONALLY, I FIND THE BEST VIEW IS FROM WITHIN THE WORKING PARTS.
Fallen Factory#055.dst: 以我個人的看法，最好的視角是從運轉的零件裡面看出來。
Fallen Factory#055.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#056.src: SO GO AHEAD - DON'T WORRY ABOUT MAKING A MESS, THE FACTORY'S CLEANING BOTS HAVE HAD PLENTY OF EXPERIENCE WASHING OUT RED STAINS.
Fallen Factory#056.dst: 所以去吧——不用擔心弄髒，工廠的清潔機器人洗紅色污漬的經驗很豐富。
Fallen Factory#056.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#057.src: DANGER! THREAT HAS BEEN DETECTED ON MAIN PRODUCTION LINE. EXECUTING SUBROUTINE {~}; LOCATE AND ELIMINATE THREAT.
Fallen Factory#057.dst: 危險！已在主生產線偵測到威脅。正在執行副程式 {~}；定位並清除威脅。
Fallen Factory#057.speaker: Antikythera

Fallen Factory#058.src: TOO BAD FOR YOU. I ACCOUNTED FOR YOU TRYING THAT AGAIN. THE GRATE IN THE VENT IS IMPENETRABLE TO EVEN YOUR BEST WEAPONS.
Fallen Factory#058.dst: 真可惜。我早就料到你會再試一次。通風管裡的格柵，連你最好的武器都穿不透。
Fallen Factory#058.speaker: Antikythera
